title: 08. Normalize aware timestamps to UTC

examples.explanation: 09:30 at -07:00 is 16:30 UTC. It is the same instant as the second timestamp.
00:15 at +02:00 on January 1 is 22:15 UTC on the previous day, in the previous year.

hints: Parse an aware datetime for each input.
Convert the instant with astimezone, then format it.
